info.description: Bearer-authenticated, server-profile-controlled router resources. Mutations require a single-use plan_id plus confirm=true. Plans expire after 120 seconds by default and are invalid after restart. Plans bind actor, profile, operation, arguments and target. Changed router state requires replanning. No automatic rollback or exactly-once delivery guarantee after an upstream failure. Non-loopback exposure requires an explicit bind and a trusted TLS proxy or encrypted tunnel.
